rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, which matched a single user. It then listed the user’s orders, confirmed the specific order, checked order details, and stated the order was pending (supported by the successful address-modification tool call). Before making changes, the agent clearly stated the exact new address (keeping unchanged fields from the existing address), asked for explicit confirmation, and only then executed the address update. The final confirmation accurately reflected the tool’s result. The agent acted only on the authenticated user’s account, did not reveal unnecessary personal data, and followed the required read-before-write and confirmation steps. No unsupported claims or policy violations observed.
